issues_summary: [Critical/Accuracy] "которые присущи" - the translation stops mid-sentence and drops the end of the clause ("inherent, rather than socially conditioned"), so the claim is incomplete and the contrast with social conditioning is lost.

[Minor/Fluency] "которые им незнакомы по родным местам" - the phrase "незнакомы по родным местам" is unidiomatic and awkward in Russian. The meaning is still recoverable. A more natural version would be "с которыми они не сталкивались у себя на родине".

[Minor/Locale convention] "более 100 футов" - Imperial units are left unconverted for ru-RU, where metric is standard (about 30 метров). The meaning is preserved, so this is minor, and it depends on whether the project style guide requires unit conversion.

[Minor/Accuracy] "по подтверждённым данным, погибли" - the source's "so far" (the toll is provisional and may rise) is not rendered; "на данный момент" or "пока" is missing. The meaning is otherwise intact.

[Major/Accuracy] "из его магазина, расположенного в гараже" - "shop" here means a workshop (мастерская), not a retail store; "магазин" changes the meaning and makes the reader stumble, since a store in a garage is odd.
[Minor/Accuracy] "Супружеская пара" - narrows "couple" to a married couple, which the source does not say; "пара" alone would be neutral.

[Minor/Fluency] "и привело к получению четырьмя людьми лёгких ожогов" - the verb "привело" is repeated and the nominalization "к получению" is clunky; "и четыре человека получили лёгкие ожоги" would read more naturally

[Minor/Terminology] "марий" - The established Russian term for lunar maria is "лунные моря" (genitive plural "морей"). The transliterated genitive plural "марий" is non-standard and may make a general reader stumble. Meaning is still recoverable, and the glossary may allow the Latin loan.
